taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-32, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQQH-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we evaluate each triplet of consecutive layer resistivities:

1. **Layers 1–2–3**: $184.7 < 735.3 > 503.9\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$ ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$) $\rightarrow$ **K**
2. **Layers 2–3–4**: $735.3 > 503.9 > 56.6\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$ ($\rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4$) $\rightarrow$ **Q**
3. **Layers 3–4–5**: $503.9 > 56.6 > 43.3\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$ ($\rho_3 > \rho_4 > \rho_5$) $\rightarrow$ **Q**
4. **Layers 4–5–6**: $56.6 > 43.3 < 520.0\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$ ($\rho_4 > \rho_5 < \rho_6$) $\rightarrow$ **H**

The resulting curve type is **KQQH**, which matches the survey classification.

{"label_correct": true, "curve_type": "KQQH"}
